title: Defer PlotModel API and renderer; close M7 S02 research
commitMessage: docs: qualify PlotModel deferral and close M7 S02

contribution.summary: Close M7-W01-C03-S02-T2 as an explicit owner-gated PlotModel/renderer deferral. Reverify RS113's SHA-pinned 1/x four-point, two-segment pole and skipped-zero break oracles, finite refusal budgets and three re-entry triggers. Complete S02 as a research spike only; keep original size-L C03, M7-W01 and M7 open, without public PlotModel, AURA renderer or package.
contribution.value: A read-only BCL checker verifies historical source hashes, the exact known 1/x discontinuity/refusal corpus and Math/client rendering boundaries. Record finite 8-sample/8-point/2-segment fixtures, distinguish 128 coordinate bytes from total managed allocations, and require consumer, resource/partial/cancellation, source/rights/RID and source-free tests before future admission.
debtChanges: A finished PlotModel research spike is not a compiled public plotting interface, renderer, adaptive sampler or third-party provider.
Reciprocal 1/x known-pole segmentation cannot establish arbitrary-function continuity, numeric error certification or physical uncertainty.
A 128-byte coordinate estimate excludes container/temporary memory, cancellation, deadlines and product-grade total byte quotas.
Any public plotting adoption requires a named caller and domain, explicit points/segments/partial-result/refusal policy, source-free consumer and owner decision.
Original size-L C03, its aggregate T1/T2 tasks, M7-W01 and M7 stay incomplete; AURA owns chart rendering and job execution.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS114 success, prepare M7-W01-C03 original aggregate T1: independently reconcile qualified S01 pure diamond DAG and S02 reciprocal no-bridge oracles, preserve the owner deferrals, scope/quotas and product nonclaims. Complete C03 only after its separate aggregate T2 gate.

achievements.achievement: Define three independent PlotModel consumer/domain, finite-point/byte/failure and graphics-owner re-entry conditions.
Reverify source-pinned RS113 1/x disconnected segments, omitted-pole break and exact nonfinite/over-quota no-partial-result oracles.
Record explicit deferral of public plotting and renderer engines, preserving strict Math/AURA ownership boundaries.
Qualify the read-only owner-gated PlotModel boundary decision without installing or publishing an engine.
Close the bounded reciprocal PlotModel research phase with an independently validated deferral, not a delivered graphing feature.
